summary: Frontend-only test of the 8 new RAMS supplementary sections at /app/tool/rams. Logged in as darrenhustle300, verified all 8 data-testids render, UI section numbering is sequential 1-23 exactly as specified, Manual Handling 'Personalised for Electrician' badge and 'cable drums' placeholder are present. Filled minimum required fields + 8 new sections, drew a live signature, intercepted the exported PDF (120KB, 5 pages), and verified via pdfplumber that all 9 distinctive content snippets and all 8 new section titles render in the PDF body. PDF section numbering is fully sequential (1..27 — no gaps, no duplicates; extra numbers beyond 23 are auto-generated PDF-only sections such as Legislation, Risk Matrix Key, Risk Register Summary, Work at Height, Briefing and Sign-Off that exist in rams-pdf.js but not in the UI form).
critical_code_review_comments: Rams.jsx is 1031 lines — consider splitting the section components/UI primitives (Inp, Drop, Area, YesNo, CheckboxRow, RatingBadge, MissingBanner, Modal) into a separate file to keep below the 700-line guideline.

PDF numbering 1..27 vs UI numbering 1..23: the spec only describes 1-23 in the UI, but rams-pdf.js auto-numbers 4 additional PDF-only sections (Legislation, Risk Matrix Key, Risk Register Summary, Work at Height) + 'Briefing and Sign-Off'. This is correct behavior but worth noting — users will see UI '23. Prepared by' map to PDF '27. Briefing and Sign-Off / Prepared by'. If parity is desired, either expose the PDF-only sections in the UI or de-couple the two numbering systems.
test_credentials: darrenhustle300 / hustle1234 (admin, trade=Electrician, fullName=Darren Morris). User has no profile signature — live signature was drawn on the canvas to satisfy export guard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RAMS PDF export flow is fully working client-side via jspdf — no /api/generate dependency. To trigger export programmatically the user must have either user.signature OR a drawn live signature; draw on the canvas inside [data-testid='rams-sig-block'] via mouse events. The UI section counter sn() resets every render so numbering is stable. PDF auto-numbers via state.sectionNum and adds 4 extra PDF-only sections beyond the 23 visible in the UI.
